data.cultural_impact: The name "Suraqah" holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic world, as it is a title given to Prophet Muhammad PBUH in some Hadith narrations. The term "Suraqah" comes from the Arabic word "sawaqah," which refers to gardens or orchards. In these Hadiths, Prophet Muhammad PBUH is described as the one who tends to the gardens of Paradise, highlighting his role as the gardener of the believers and the one who prepares the gardens of Paradise for them.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Suraqah" lies in the concept of Prophet Muhammad PBUH being the caretaker of the gardens of Paradise, which represents his role as the intercessor and provider of spiritual nourishment to his followers. This title also symbolizes the importance of paradise in Islamic beliefs, as it is described as a place of eternal beauty and joy, where God's blessings are abundant.
